about.title: Family run
paragraphs: Kempton's Vehicle Maintenance is a family-run shop in Milwaukie, owned by Brian and run with Brandon. We work hard, skip the fluff, and do it right so you won't have to bring it back.

estimate.title: What's going on with your car?
estimate.text: Tell us what your vehicle is doing and Brian or Brandon will get back to you. Or call (503) 653-3976 (Mon–Fri: 8am–6pm).
estimate.thanks: Thanks! Brian or Brandon will get back to you soon to set up a time.
